label: Hoi An
short_description: The UNESCO-listed Ancient Town and the Cua Dai beach strip just east of it.
intro: Hoi An's hotel coverage in this directory sits along the short stretch between the UNESCO-listed Ancient Town and Cua Dai beach, a few minutes apart by shuttle or bicycle. Properties here lean boutique and colonial-revival in style rather than high-rise, reflecting the town's low-height heritage zoning, and most guests split their days between the riverside Old Town's lantern-lit streets and the beach. Da Nang International Airport is roughly 30-45 minutes away by car, making Hoi An a common add-on to a Da Nang stay rather than a fly-in destination of its own.
